derivation: acc = bias_int32[oc] + sum over taps of code*weight_code (int32)
code = clamp( (acc*M0 + (acc*M0 >= 0 ? 2^(shift-1) : 2^(shift-1)-1)) >> shift, lo, hi ), lo/hi per the op's activation: relu [0,127], signed [-127,127], unsigned head [0,255]
reflect padding (edge not repeated) precedes every 3x3 convolution
add (residual): sum = clamp_sym(requant(branch)) + trunk with branch = point 1 and trunk = point 3; the sum is NOT clamped, it is the 9-bit activation the head reads
upsample_nearest2x duplicates every code into a 2x2 block
M0/shift are derived independently from the manifest's f32 requant vectors
